experiment: P3o-I durable finite-valid bounded compound-CVaR residual
research_question: Under the unchanged finite-valid bounded residual and compound-CVaR comparison, can the independently persisted three-seed protocol satisfy the cross-identity worst-combination gates?

methods.F_base: Unchanged selected F backbone with BCEWithLogits plus 0.1 masked SmoothL1.
methods.I0_bounded_mean: Unchanged P3o-H finite-valid, bounded, state-preserving delay residual with mean loss.
methods.I1_bounded_combo_cvar: Exactly I0, with the pre-registered equal-weight upper-tail compound-label-group CVaR term.

durability_protocol: Each model seed runs in a distinct Python process and output directory. The runner writes a result summary on success or an exception receipt with traceback on failure; CUDA cache is released on process exit. An aggregator may merge only three successful fixed-seed summaries and cannot select checkpoints or thresholds.

training.calibration: F-only calibration, verbatim reuse by I0/I1

decision_rule: Only an all-gate merged three-seed pass permits exactly the 1350M confirmation. Any seed exception, missing seed receipt, numerical non-finiteness, or gate failure freezes P3o-I; no identity, hyperparameter, threshold or checkpoint may be retried.
